content.text:
**Finding: compliant (MFN).**

The Agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation of any kind. Sparkling's sole pricing obligation is §11: "Sparkling shall pay the fees as set out in the Fee Schedule in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and the Fee Schedule." Maintenance pricing (§10) is likewise fixed by reference to the Fee Schedule, and General Matters contains no best-terms, disclosure, or right-to-match mechanic. This satisfies the preferred position (no Customer MFN benefiting Vendor), so no redline was proposed.
